column1: hobble§A loose strap hobbled the horse without hurting it.§一条**松绊索**拴住了马，却没有伤到它。
hodgepodge§The law is a hodgepodge of amendments nobody has ever reconciled.§这部法律是一堆从未有人梳理过的修正案的**杂烩**。
hog§A hog roast marked the end of the harvest every year.§每年收获季结束时都要烤一头**猪**。
holistic§A holistic estimate includes the cost of doing nothing.§**整体的**估算要把什么都不做的代价也算进去。
hospitable§The climate here is hospitable to vines and hostile to wheat.§这里的气候**宜于**葡萄，却不利于小麦。
hospitality§Hospitality in the highlands is an obligation, not a favour.§在高地，**好客**是义务，而不是恩惠。
hostility§Hostility to the plan came mostly from people who had not read it.§对这个计划的**敌意**，多半来自没读过它的人。
hubris§There is a quiet hubris in never asking for a second opinion.§从不征求第二种意见，是一种安静的**傲慢**。
humane§A humane hour to hold a meeting is not before nine.§**人道的**开会时间不该早于九点。
humility§Humility about method is what makes a bold claim credible.§正是方法上的**谦逊**，让大胆的主张变得可信。
hybrid§The building is a hybrid of warehouse and concert hall.§这座建筑是仓库与音乐厅的**混合**体。
hypothetical§Answer the hypothetical and the real question answers itself.§回答了那个**假设**的问题，真正的问题就自己解开了。
hysterical§The coverage was hysterical and the event was not.§报道**歇斯底里**，事件本身却不是。
icon§On screen the icon is a floppy disk nobody has ever used.§屏幕上那个**图标**是一张没人用过的软盘。
iconoclast§Every iconoclast eventually becomes somebody's icon.§每个**打破偶像**的人最终都会成为别人的偶像。
iconoclastic§An iconoclastic reading is not the same as a careless one.§**打破成规**的解读与粗心的解读不是一回事。
idealist§The idealist keeps the argument honest and the realist keeps it going.§**理想主义者**让论证保持诚实，现实主义者让它继续下去。
idealize§Do not idealize a method just because it is old.§不要因为一种方法古老就把它**理想化**。
ideologue§An ideologue will accept the data and keep the conclusion.§**理论家**会接受数据，同时保住结论。
idiosyncratic§His idiosyncratic spelling makes the diary hard to search.§他**特异**的拼写让这本日记很难检索。
ignominy§There is no ignominy in withdrawing from bad conditions.§因条件恶劣而退出并不**可耻**。
illegible§An illegible signature has settled more disputes than it started.§**潦草**的签名了结的争端比它引起的还多。
illicit§Illicit copies preserved a text the censor destroyed.§**非法**抄本保存下了审查者销毁的文本。
illuminate§Two lamps illuminate the whole reading room.§两盏灯**照亮**了整个阅览室。
illusory§The symmetry is illusory; measure it and the two halves differ.§这种对称是**假象**，一量就知道两半不同。
imaginative§Imaginative is not a synonym for unrealistic.§富有**想象**力并不等于不切实际。
imbecile§He called the rule imbecile and obeyed it for thirty years.§他骂这条规矩**愚蠢**，却遵守了三十年。
imbue§The place is imbued with a quiet nobody plans for.§这个地方**浸透**着一种无人刻意安排的安静。
imitation§Imitation is how every craft is actually transmitted.§**模仿**才是每一门手艺真正的传承方式。
immaterial§Cost is immaterial when the alternative is losing the collection.§当另一种可能是失去整批藏品时，成本**无关紧要**。
immature§The fruit is immature in July and unrecognizable in September.§这种果实七月还**未成熟**，到九月就认不出来了。
immersion§Language immersion works because it removes the option of translating.§语言**浸入**之所以有效，是因为它取消了翻译这个选项。
immobile§The dial stayed immobile for six hours and then jumped.§指针六小时纹丝**不动**，随后跳了一下。
immobility§Immobility of the joint was the first symptom she reported.§关节**不能活动**是她报告的第一个症状。
immoderate§An immoderate response to a small slight is itself information.§对一点小怠慢**反应过度**，本身就是一种信息。
immoral§The novel asks whether a beautiful thing can be immoral.§这部小说追问一件美的东西是否可能是**不道德**的。
immorality§Immorality in the abstract convinces nobody; a case does.§抽象地谈**不道德**说服不了谁，一个具体案例可以。
immutable§Physical constants are immutable; our estimates of them are not.§物理常数是**不变的**，我们对它们的估计却不是。
impartial§Impartial does not mean having no view.§**公正**并不意味着没有立场。
impasse§They broke the impasse by changing the room.§他们换了个房间，打破了**僵局**。
impassioned§An impassioned plea from the floor changed nothing and mattered.§场下一段**慷慨的陈情**什么也没改变，却很重要。
impassive§The sea was impassive and gave nothing back.§大海**冷漠**无情，什么也不回应。
impeccable§His references were impeccable and entirely invented.§他的推荐信**无懈可击**，也完全是编造的。
impediment§There is no legal impediment to the sale.§这项出售没有法律**障碍**。
impenetrable§An impenetrable hedge kept the garden private for a century.§一道**无法穿透**的树篱让这座花园私密了一个世纪。
impenitent§An impenitent tone in an apology cancels it out.§道歉里**毫无悔意**的语气会把道歉抵消掉。
imperceptible§An imperceptible slope drains the whole courtyard.§一道**察觉不到**的坡度排干了整个庭院。
imperceptive§It was imperceptive of me to read the letter as a complaint.§我把那封信读成抱怨，是**没看出门道**。
imperious§An imperious gesture from the doorway ended the rehearsal.§门口一个**专横的**手势结束了排练。
impermeability§Impermeability is what makes the layer both useful and dangerous.§**不透水性**使这一层既有用又危险。
impersonal§The city is impersonal in the way a large library is.§这座城市的**冷淡**，就像一座大图书馆的冷淡。
imperturbable§Imperturbable in a crisis, he was hopeless at small talk.§危机中他**镇定自若**，闲聊却一塌糊涂。
impervious§He is impervious to flattery and susceptible to a good argument.§他对奉承**无动于衷**，对有力的论证却很受用。
impetuosity§Impetuosity in a first draft is often a virtue.§初稿里的**冲动**往往是优点。
impetuous§An impetuous decision made in June looked sound by December.§六月一个**冲动的**决定，到十二月看来是明智的。
implacable§Time is implacable and does not negotiate.§时间**毫不留情**，也不谈判。
implausibility§The implausibility lies in the timing, not the motive.§**不可信**之处在于时间，而不在动机。
implausible§Implausible things happen; that is why we keep records.§**不可思议**的事确实会发生，所以我们才留记录。
impossibility§What was an impossibility in 1950 is now a school exercise.§一九五〇年**不可能**的事，如今是学校的练习题。
impoverish§A narrow syllabus impoverishes the students who work hardest.§狭窄的教学大纲最**亏待**那些最用功的学生。
impractical§An impractical idea can still be the right direction.§**不切实际的**想法仍可能指对了方向。
imprecise§Imprecise language is how most disputes actually start.§多数争端其实都始于**不精确的**语言。
impressionable§He was impressionable at exactly the right moment.§他恰好在对的时候容**易受影响**。
impressionistic§An impressionistic map is useless for navigation and good for memory.§**印象式**的地图不能用来导航，却有助于记忆。
improbable§The improbable explanation turned out to be the true one.§那个**不太可能**的解释最后被证明是真的。
impromptu§An impromptu speech is only good if the thinking was done earlier.§**即席**演讲要讲得好，前提是思考早已完成。
improvident§Improvident planting exhausted the soil in two generations.§**没有远见**的耕种在两代人内耗尽了地力。
improvisational§Improvisational skill comes from knowing the piece cold.§**即兴的**能力来自把曲子背得滚瓜烂熟。
